# EXECUTIVE FUNDING PROPOSAL **To:** The Principal Secretary, Department of Expenditure (Treasury) & Chief Engineer, Public Works Department (PWD) **From:** Office of the Superintending Engineer, PWD Circle, Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh **Date:** October 24, 2023 **Subject:** Emergency Funding Allocation for Pavement Rehabilitation and Hospital Transit Restoration – Assi Ghat Main Road (Hotspot ID: hotspot-1) --- ### 1. Executive Summary & Problem Statement This proposal requests immediate emergency capital allocation for the comprehensive rehabilitation of **Assi Ghat Main Road, Varanasi** (Coordinates: 25.29° N, 83.01° E). The corridor is currently experiencing catastrophic pavement failure categorized under **Potholes / Washout**, resulting in a critically low **Road Condition Index (RCI) of 35**. With an **Urgency Score of 5/5** and **42 active citizen complaints** logged via the state grievance portal, this arterial route has deteriorated to a highly hazardous state. The severe structural washouts impede traffic, compromise vehicular safety, and present an immediate risk of localized transit paralysis along a vital urban corridor. --- ### 2. Real-Time Policy Compliance & Engineering Standards All proposed corrective measures and materials will strictly adhere to national statutory guidelines and design standards: * **MoRTH Specifications (Section 500 & 3000):** Re-paving works will comply with the Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (MoRTH) standards for Bituminous Macadam (BM) and Semi-Dense Bituminous Concrete (SDBC) to ensure long-term durability against high shear stress. * **IRC:82-2015 Compliance:** Maintenance and structural rehabilitation designs will follow the Indian Roads Congress (IRC) guidelines for the maintenance of bituminous road surfaces. * **IRC:SP:50 (Urban Drainage):** To prevent future washouts, integrated roadside drainage rehabilitation will be executed in compliance with urban storm-water management protocols, ensuring rapid runoff evacuation. --- ### 3. Expected Population Impact & Community Benefits The Assi Ghat Main Road serves as a high-density urban artery with a **Population Density Score of 85**. * **Target Beneficiaries:** This project directly impacts approximately **45,000 residents**, local businesses, and daily commuters. * **Emergency Hospital Transit:** This route is the primary ambulance corridor connecting the southern riverfront zone to major tertiary healthcare centers, including Sir Sunderlal Hospital (BHU). Re-paving will eliminate life-threatening transit delays for emergency vehicles. * **Socio-Economic Benefit:** Restoring smooth traffic flow will drastically reduce vehicle operating costs (VOC), eliminate congestion-linked emission spikes, and guarantee safe, hazard-free pedestrian access to the high-traffic Assi Ghat cultural zone. --- ### 4. Estimated Budget Allocation Recommendation To address the critical distress of the pavement and ensure structural resilience against future washouts, PWD recommends a total emergency allocation of **₹1,45,00,000 (INR 1.45 Crore)**. | Item No. | Work Description | Compliance / Standard | Budget Allocation (INR) | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **1.0** | **Site Preparation & Sub-base Stabilization**
*(Removal of damaged crust, sub-grade compaction, and WMM corrective course)* | MoRTH Section 400 | ₹ 30,00,000 | | **2.0** | **Bituminous Re-paving & Surfacing**
*(Application of tack coat, BM, and SDBC wearing course)* | MoRTH Section 500 / IRC:82 | ₹ 75,00,000 | | **3.0** | **Drainage Rehabilitation & Washout Prevention**
*(Re-construction of micro-drains and masonry retaining structures)* | IRC:SP:50 | ₹ 25,00,000 | | **4.0** | **Road Marking, Signage, & Traffic Safety Measures**
*(Thermoplastic markings, cat-eyes, and emergency transit priority signs)* | IRC:35 & IRC:67 | ₹ 10,00,000 | | **5.0** | **Quality Control, Contingency, & Third-Party Audit** | PWD State Manual | ₹ 5,00,000 | | **Total** | **Estimated Project Cost** | | **₹ 1,45,00,000** | ### 5. Recommendation Given the extreme public hazard, critical RCI rating, and vital medical transit utility of the Assi Ghat Main Road, it is requested that this project be approved under the **Emergency Asset Restoration Fund** to bypass typical tendering delays. Technical sanctions are pre-approved at the zonal level; execution can commence within 7 days of financial clearance. **Submitted for Administrative Approval & Financial Sanction.**
